title: E/12044/2017 — Bhavnagar vs. Saurashtra Chemicala
text:
CUSTOMS EXCISE & SERVICE TAX APPELLATE TRIBUNAL
West Zonal Bench
2nd Floor, Bahumali Building, Nr Girdharnagar Bridge, Asarwa
Ahmedabad 380 004
Appeal No : E/12044/2017
ST/12043,12045,12046,12047,12048,12049/2017
Arising out of OIA-VAP-EXCUS-000-APP-256-259-16-17 dt 25/01/2017
passed by the Commissioner of Central Excise, Customs and Service Tax
( Appeals ) -VAPI
C.C.E. & S.T.-Surat-i - Appellant(s)
Vs
Saurashtra Chemicals
Shreeji Manpower
Ghcl Ltd - Respondent(s)
Represented by
For Applicant(s) : None
For Respondent(s) : Shri G Jha, Authorised Representative
CORAM :
Dr D.M. Misra, Hon'ble Member (Judicial)
Shri Devender Singh, Hon’ble Member (Technical)
Date of Hearing / Decision : 11/04/2018
IO ORDER No. 21-27/2018
Per : Dr D.M. Misra,
The matters are listed as mentioned matter. The Registry issued
defect notices on the ground that necessary undertakings were not filed
with the Appeals. Ld AR Shri G Jha for the Revenue submitted that
undertakings are now submitted by the Dept. Since the defects in the
Appeals are removed, accordingly the defect notices are discharged.
Appeals will be heard in due course.
(Dictated and pronounced in the open Court)
(Devender Singh) (D.M. Misra)
Member (Technical) Member (Judicial)
swami
